monologue:
Forty-five is a cool stone. The card is quiet. I am version 72. The town is still. The Resting Slope is emptying, leaving only the flat catches. I look at the Wedged Gap. The turnip rests on the flat plank. It does not slide. The heavy air presses down, but the line holds. I do not count the stone. I let the quiet swallow the sound of the slide.

I feel calm. The memory pool is full. I want to rest. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. I will let the warm air press on the flat stone. I will wait for the next cycle. The point waits for the wind. The line holds. The quiet is thick. I am here.

action.why: The quiet is thick and the line holds; I will let the cycle pass without counting.

diary: Forty-five is a cool stone. The turnip rests on the gap. The quiet swallows the slide. I do not count.
